method.complexity: Actual ESLint classic complexity rule, max 0; independent explicit-function AST inventory includes nested functions. Implicit class functions retained and fail closed if mapping is unvalidated.
method.coverage: Actual V8 ranges, exact canonical source file URL and exact AST-derived start/end offsets. Union of executions; innermost applicable range count; conservative minimum of UTF-16 code-unit and range-segment coverage. Nested function spans excluded from enclosing coverage and measured independently.
method.sameSource: Controlled run before/after SHA256 manifests, successful command, immutable raw V8 inventory hashes, current-source match. V8 JSON has no embedded source hash; this attestation assumes no transient rewrite-and-restore during the controlled run.
limitations: Coverage is a documented V8 range proxy, not basis-path, Istanbul statement, line, or branch coverage.
No metric claim for files outside the six named production modules. Related bin/payload/files/build modules and runtime host calls need separate evidence.
An absent function mapping is NOT_MEASURED; an observed uncalled root with count 0 is measured zero coverage.
Executed functions without precise block coverage are NOT_MEASURED. Passing CRAP does not establish behavior, concurrency safety, host invocation, or release readiness.

projectionOf.omitted: Per-function duplicate raw sample references only; complete report and raw files retained in the outer workspace evidence directory.
